target.label: observed source MLC > 0
target.curation: 16597 observed source labels; 41 missing primary readings excluded

applicability.assembly: assembled DNA FASTA; completeness and taxonomic identity are not inferred
applicability.range_checks: Descriptive training-envelope flags only; not calibrated out-of-distribution detection or validation for a query.
applicability.unsupported_species: An explicitly supplied different species yields not_estimated for every candidate.

limitations: Scores are research rankings for the source assay, not calibrated infection probabilities or cocktail/treatment effects.
The source development comparison did not establish robust improvement; no release validation or SDL decision admission.
